change_env.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: change_env.sh [Development|Test|Staging|Production]. The environment the service runs as.
# It is a harbor command now; this script only calls it.
[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || exec sudo "$0" "$@"
exec "@APACHE_DIR@/../bin/harbor" site action @SITE@ change_env "${1:-}"
#!/bin/bash
clear

_service=/etc/systemd/system/@SERVICE_NAME@.service
_env=${1:-}

if [[ ! -f ${_service} ]]; then
	echo "Service file not found: ${_service}" >&2
	exit 1
fi

echo "Current environment:"
grep "_ENVIRONMENT" "${_service}"
echo

if [[ -z ${_env} ]]; then
	echo "1) Development"
	echo "2) Test"
	echo "3) Staging"
	echo "4) Production"
	read -r -p "Choose environment: " _env
fi

case "${_env,,}" in
	1 | d | dev | development) _env=Development ;;
	2 | t | test) _env=Test ;;
	3 | s | stage | staging) _env=Staging ;;
	4 | p | prod | production) _env=Production ;;
	*) echo "Unknown environment: ${_env}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

sudo sed -i -E "s|^(Environment=(ASPNETCORE\|DOTNET)_ENVIRONMENT=).*|\1${_env}|" "${_service}"

echo "Environment is now:"
grep "_ENVIRONMENT" "${_service}"

sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart @SERVICE_NAME@
sudo systemctl status @SERVICE_NAME@ --no-pager

clear_logs_prod.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Clear the Umbraco logs on the Windows server. The site is offline briefly, as IIS keeps the log files open.
# This file contains a password: keep it readable by root only (chmod 700).
[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || exec sudo "$0" "$@"
set -euo pipefail
source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/windows_prod.sh"

# ---- Production settings (filled in by create_prod.sh, edit if needed) -----
PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE=@PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE@   # The IIS site's folder, e.g. //server/share/site-folder
PROD_SMB_USER=@PROD_SMB_USER@
PROD_SMB_PASSWORD=@PROD_SMB_PASSWORD@
PROD_SMB_DOMAIN=@PROD_SMB_DOMAIN@         # Empty if the server is not on a domain
PROD_OFFLINE_WAIT=5                       # Seconds IIS gets to release its files after app_offline.htm
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

on_exit() {
	local _status=$?
	# Always bring the site back up, also if deleting fails
	windows_bring_online || _status=1
	exit "${_status}"
}
trap on_exit EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT TERM

windows_smb_connect
_logs=${_windowsTarget}/umbraco/Logs
if ! rclone lsf "${_logs}" --max-depth 1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
	echo "Nothing to delete: umbraco/Logs not found"
	exit 0
fi

windows_take_offline
rclone purge "${_logs}"
echo "Deleted umbraco/Logs"
#!/bin/bash
# Clear the Umbraco logs on the production server over SSH.
set -euo pipefail

# ---- Production settings (filled in by create_prod.sh, edit if needed) -----
PROD_LOCAL_PATH=@PROD_LOCAL_PATH@   # If set: clear logs in this local folder instead of on a remote server
PROD_IP=@PROD_IP@                   # IP or hostname of the production server
PROD_USER=@PROD_USER@               # SSH login
PROD_PASSWORD=@PROD_PASSWORD@       # SSH password (needs sshpass). Empty = use an SSH key
PROD_SSH_PORT=@PROD_SSH_PORT@
PROD_FOLDER=@PROD_FOLDER@           # Site name on prod (/var/www/<folder>)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

if [[ -n ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH} ]]; then
	# Local folder: no service is managed, only the log folder is deleted
	_root=${PROD_LOCAL_PATH%/}
	_sudo=""
	[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || _sudo="sudo"
	_dir="${_root}/umbraco/Logs"
	if [[ -d ${_dir} ]]; then
		${_sudo} rm -rf "${_dir}"
		echo "Deleted ${_dir}"
	else
		echo "Nothing to delete: ${_dir} not found"
	fi
	exit 0
fi

if [[ -z ${PROD_IP} || -z ${PROD_USER} || -z ${PROD_FOLDER} ]]; then
	echo "Set PROD_IP, PROD_USER and PROD_FOLDER (or PROD_LOCAL_PATH) at the top of this script" >&2
	exit 1
fi

_ssh=(ssh -p "${PROD_SSH_PORT}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new)
if [[ -n ${PROD_PASSWORD} ]]; then
	command -v sshpass >/dev/null || { echo "sshpass is required for password login: sudo apt install sshpass" >&2; exit 1; }
	export SSHPASS=${PROD_PASSWORD}
	_ssh=(sshpass -e "${_ssh[@]}")
fi
_sudo=""
[[ ${PROD_USER} == root ]] || _sudo="sudo -n"

"${_ssh[@]}" "${PROD_USER}@${PROD_IP}" "${_sudo} bash -s" <<REMOTE
set -e
systemctl stop '${PROD_FOLDER}'
_dir='/var/www/${PROD_FOLDER}/umbraco/Logs'
if [[ -d "\${_dir}" ]]; then
	rm -rf "\${_dir}"
	echo "Deleted \${_dir}"
else
	echo "Nothing to delete: \${_dir} not found"
fi
systemctl start '${PROD_FOLDER}'
systemctl status '${PROD_FOLDER}' --no-pager
REMOTE

create_prod.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Add a production target to this site, either on a remote server (SSH) or in a local folder.
# Asks for the production settings, then:
#   publish.sh -> publish_local.sh, clear_logs.sh -> clear_logs_local.sh
#   creates publish_prod.sh, clear_logs_prod.sh and sync_prod.sh (Umbraco) with the answers filled in
# Production is always a Release build. This script deletes itself when it is done.
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $EUID -ne 0 ]]; then
	exec sudo "$0" "$@"
fi

source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/common.sh"

# Values baked in when the site was created
_site=@SITE@
_binding=@BINDING@
_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_siteRoot=@SITE_ROOT@
_publishFolder=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@
_adminMail=@ADMIN_MAIL@
_kind=@CSHARP_KIND@

_scripts="${_siteRoot}/scripts"
_self=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)/$(basename "$0")
_templates=("${_solutionFolder}/csharp/prod-scripts")
[[ ${_kind} == umbraco ]] && _templates+=("${_solutionFolder}/csharp/umbraco/prod-scripts")

if [[ ! -f ${_scripts}/publish.sh || -e ${_scripts}/publish_local.sh || -e ${_scripts}/publish_prod.sh ]]; then
	echo "A production target has already been created for this site (or publish.sh is missing)." >&2
	exit 1
fi

_target=${1:-}
ask _target "Production target (remote/local)" remote
_localPath=""
_ip=""
_user=""
_password=""
_sshPort=""
case "${_target}" in
	remote)
		ask _ip "Production server IP or hostname"
		[[ -n ${_ip} ]] || { echo "IP is required." >&2; exit 1; }
		ask _user "SSH login" root
		read -r -s -p "SSH password (empty = use an SSH key): " _password
		echo
		ask _sshPort "SSH port" 22
		[[ ${_sshPort} =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "SSH port must be a number." >&2; exit 1; }
		_defaultFolder=${_site}
		;;
	local)
		ask _localPath "Local production folder (absolute path)" "${_siteRoot}/_prod"
		[[ ${_localPath} == /* ]] || { echo "The path must be absolute." >&2; exit 1; }
		_defaultFolder=${_site}-prod
		;;
	*)
		echo "Target must be remote or local." >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac

ask _prodFolder "Production site name (folder /var/www/<name>, service and Apache config)" "${_defaultFolder}"
validate_site_name "${_prodFolder}"
ask _prodBinding "Production binding (domain)" "${_prodFolder}"
validate_binding "${_prodBinding}"
if [[ ${_target} == local ]]; then
	if [[ ${_prodFolder} == "${_site}" || ${_prodBinding} == "${_binding}" ]]; then
		echo "A local production site needs a different name and binding than this site." >&2
		exit 1
	fi
fi
echo
echo "Target:   ${_target}${_ip:+ (${_user}@${_ip}:${_sshPort})}${_localPath:+ (${_localPath})}"
echo "Site:     ${_prodFolder}"
echo "Binding:  ${_prodBinding}"
read -r -p "Create the production scripts? [Y/n]: " _confirm
[[ ${_confirm:-y} =~ ^[Yy] ]] || { echo "Cancelled."; exit 1; }

_q() { printf '%q' "$1"; }
export R_PROD_LOCAL_PATH="$(_q "${_localPath}")" R_PROD_IP="$(_q "${_ip}")" R_PROD_USER="$(_q "${_user}")" \
	R_PROD_PASSWORD="$(_q "${_password}")" R_PROD_SSH_PORT="$(_q "${_sshPort}")" R_PROD_FOLDER="$(_q "${_prodFolder}")" \
	R_PROD_BINDING="$(_q "${_prodBinding}")" R_ADMIN_MAIL="${_adminMail}" \
	R_PROJECT_NAME="${_projectName}" R_PUBLISH_FOLDER="${_publishFolder}" R_SITE="${_site}"

# Render everything first, so a missing template fails before anything is renamed
_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "${_tmp}"' EXIT
for _dir in "${_templates[@]}"; do
	for _file in "${_dir}"/*.sh; do
		[[ -f ${_file} ]] || continue
		perl -pe 's/\@([A-Z_]+)\@/exists $ENV{"R_$1"} ? $ENV{"R_$1"} : "\@$1\@"/ge' "${_file}" >"${_tmp}/$(basename "${_file}")"
	done
done
[[ -f ${_tmp}/publish_prod.sh ]] || { echo "Template publish_prod.sh not found." >&2; exit 1; }

mv "${_scripts}/publish.sh" "${_scripts}/publish_local.sh"
[[ ! -f ${_scripts}/clear_logs.sh ]] || mv "${_scripts}/clear_logs.sh" "${_scripts}/clear_logs_local.sh"
for _file in "${_tmp}"/*.sh; do
	install -m 700 "${_file}" "${_scripts}/$(basename "${_file}")"
done

echo "Created in ${_scripts}:"
ls -1 "${_scripts}" | grep -E '_(local|prod)\.sh$' | sed 's/^/  /'
echo "Next: run publish_prod.sh to publish to production."

rm -f -- "${_self}"

	if [[ ${_destinationHasFiles} == y && ${VNS_PROD_NO_PUBLISH:-} != 1 ]]; then

#!/bin/bash
# Add a production target to this site: a remote Linux server (SSH), a local folder, or an IIS site on a Windows server (SMB).
# Asks for the production settings, then:
#   publish.sh -> publish_local.sh, clear_logs.sh -> clear_logs_local.sh (the first time)
#   creates scripts/targets/<environment>/ with publish_prod.sh, clear_logs_prod.sh and sync_prod.sh (Umbraco)
# Publishes production, then syncs content when available. Production is always a Release build.
# A remote or Windows destination that already holds a site is adopted as it is: its settings are read from the
# server, it must run the dll this site builds, and nothing is published, synced or changed there.
# Run it again to add another environment.
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $EUID -ne 0 ]]; then
	exec sudo "$0" "$@"
fi

source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/common.sh"

# Values baked in when the site was created
_site=@SITE@
_binding=@BINDING@
_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_siteRoot=@SITE_ROOT@
_publishFolder=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@
_adminMail=@ADMIN_MAIL@
_kind=@CSHARP_KIND@

_scripts="${_siteRoot}/scripts"
_self=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)/$(basename "$0")
_tmp=""
cleanup() {
	[[ -z ${_tmp} ]] || rm -rf "${_tmp}"
	if [[ ${VNS_PROD_MODAL:-} == 1 ]]; then
		rm -f -- "${_self}"
	fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [[ ! -f ${_scripts}/publish.sh && ! -f ${_scripts}/publish_local.sh ]]; then
	echo "This site has no publish.sh." >&2
	exit 1
fi

_localPath=""
_ip=""
_user=""
_password=""
_sshPort=""
_smbShare=""
_smbUser=""
_smbPassword=""
_smbDomain=""
_https=""

	_target=${VNS_PROD_TARGET:-}
	_localPath=${VNS_PROD_LOCAL_PATH:-}
	_ip=${VNS_PROD_IP:-}
	_user=${VNS_PROD_USER:-}
	_password=${VNS_PROD_PASSWORD:-}
	_sshPort=${VNS_PROD_SSH_PORT:-22}
	_prodFolder=${VNS_PROD_FOLDER:-}
	_prodBinding=${VNS_PROD_BINDING:-}
	_prodEnvironment=${VNS_PROD_ENVIRONMENT:-Production}
	_smbShare=${VNS_PROD_SMB_SHARE:-}
	_smbUser=${VNS_PROD_SMB_USER:-}
	_smbPassword=${VNS_PROD_SMB_PASSWORD:-}
	_smbDomain=${VNS_PROD_SMB_DOMAIN:-}
	_https=${VNS_PROD_HTTPS:-y}

	_target=${1:-}
	ask _target "Production target (remote/local/windows)" remote

		remote)
			ask _ip "Production server IP or hostname"
			[[ -n ${_ip} ]] || { echo "IP is required." >&2; exit 1; }

		local)
			ask _localPath "Local production folder (absolute path)" "${_siteRoot}/_prod"

			_defaultFolder=prod-${_site}

		windows)
			echo "The IIS site and its folder must already exist on the Windows server."

			ask _smbUser "SMB username" Administrator
			read -r -s -p "SMB password: " _smbPassword
			echo
			ask _smbDomain "SMB domain (empty = the server is not on a domain)"
			;;
		*)
			echo "Target must be remote, local or windows." >&2
			exit 1
			;;
	esac
	if [[ ${_target} == windows ]]; then
		ask _prodBinding "Production binding (the domain of the IIS site)" "${_binding}"
		_prodFolder=${_prodBinding}
	else
		ask _prodFolder "Production site name (folder /var/www/<name>, service and Apache config)" "${_defaultFolder}"

	ask _prodEnvironment "Environment (Development/Test/Staging/Production)" Production

		_httpsDefault=y
	fi

	else

	fi
fi

	Development | Test | Staging | Production) ;;
	*) echo "Environment must be Development, Test, Staging or Production." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "${_https,,}" in
	y | yes) _https=y ;;
	n | no) _https=n ;;

esac

validate_site_name "${_prodFolder}"
validate_binding "${_prodBinding}"

	if [[ ! ${_smbShare} =~ ^//[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*/[^/]+(/[^/]+)+$ || /${_smbShare}/ == */../* || /${_smbShare}/ == */./* ]]; then

		exit 1
	fi

	[[ ${_localPath} == /* ]] || { echo "The local production folder must be an absolute path." >&2; exit 1; }

		exit 1

	if [[ ${_localPath%/} != "${_siteRoot}"/* ]]; then
		if [[ ${VNS_PROD_NO_PUBLISH:-} != 1 && ${_localPath%/} != "${_rootPath}/${_prodFolder}" ]]; then
			echo "A folder outside this site must be ${_rootPath}/${_prodFolder} (${_rootPath}/<production site name>)." >&2
			exit 1

		fi
	fi

		source <(grep -E '^PROD_[A-Z_]+=' "${_file}")
		[[ ${_target} == local && -n ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH} ]] || exit 0
		if [[ ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH%/} == "${_localPath%/}" || $(normalize_dns_name "${PROD_FOLDER}" unit) == "$(normalize_dns_name "${_prodFolder}" unit)" ]]; then
			echo "Another environment on this server already uses that folder or site name." >&2
			exit 1
		fi
	)

	_targetId=${_prodEnvironment,,}-${_number}
	_number=$((_number + 1))

echo "Binding:  ${_prodBinding}"
echo "Environment: ${_prodEnvironment}"

	read -r -p "Create the production scripts? [Y/n]: " _confirm
	[[ ${_confirm:-y} =~ ^[Yy] ]] || { echo "Cancelled."; exit 1; }

	_templates=("${_solutionFolder}/csharp/windows-prod-scripts")

		rclone lsf "${_windowsTarget}" --max-depth 1

		[[ -z ${_name} ]] || rclone copyto "${_windowsTarget}/${_name}" "${_webConfig}" >&2

if [[ ${VNS_PROD_NO_PUBLISH:-} == 1 ]]; then
	exit 0
fi

echo "Publish to ${_prodEnvironment}"
bash "${_targetFolder}/publish_prod.sh"
if [[ -f ${_targetFolder}/sync_prod.sh ]]; then
	echo "Sync content to ${_prodEnvironment}"
	bash "${_targetFolder}/sync_prod.sh"
fi
echo "Environment ${_targetId} is ready."
#!/bin/bash
# Add a production target to this site: a remote Linux server (SSH), a local folder, or an IIS site on a Windows server (SMB).
# Asks for the production settings, then:
#   publish.sh -> publish_local.sh, clear_logs.sh -> clear_logs_local.sh (the first time)
#   creates scripts/targets/<environment>/ with publish_prod.sh, clear_logs_prod.sh and sync_prod.sh (Umbraco)
# Publishes production, then syncs content when available. Production is always a Release build.
# Run it again to add another environment.
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $EUID -ne 0 ]]; then
	exec sudo "$0" "$@"
fi

source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/common.sh"

# Values baked in when the site was created
_site=@SITE@
_binding=@BINDING@
_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_siteRoot=@SITE_ROOT@
_publishFolder=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@
_adminMail=@ADMIN_MAIL@
_kind=@CSHARP_KIND@

_scripts="${_siteRoot}/scripts"
_self=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)/$(basename "$0")
_tmp=""
cleanup() {
	[[ -z ${_tmp} ]] || rm -rf "${_tmp}"
	if [[ ${VNS_PROD_MODAL:-} == 1 ]]; then
		rm -f -- "${_self}"
	fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [[ ! -f ${_scripts}/publish.sh && ! -f ${_scripts}/publish_local.sh ]]; then
	echo "This site has no publish.sh." >&2
	exit 1
fi

_localPath=""
_ip=""
_user=""
_password=""
_sshPort=""
_smbShare=""
_smbUser=""
_smbPassword=""
_smbDomain=""
_https=""
if [[ ${VNS_PROD_MODAL:-} == 1 ]]; then
	_target=${VNS_PROD_TARGET:-}
	_localPath=${VNS_PROD_LOCAL_PATH:-}
	_ip=${VNS_PROD_IP:-}
	_user=${VNS_PROD_USER:-}
	_password=${VNS_PROD_PASSWORD:-}
	_sshPort=${VNS_PROD_SSH_PORT:-22}
	_prodFolder=${VNS_PROD_FOLDER:-}
	_prodBinding=${VNS_PROD_BINDING:-}
	_prodEnvironment=${VNS_PROD_ENVIRONMENT:-Production}
	_smbShare=${VNS_PROD_SMB_SHARE:-}
	_smbUser=${VNS_PROD_SMB_USER:-}
	_smbPassword=${VNS_PROD_SMB_PASSWORD:-}
	_smbDomain=${VNS_PROD_SMB_DOMAIN:-}
	_https=${VNS_PROD_HTTPS:-y}
else
	_target=${1:-}
	ask _target "Production target (remote/local/windows)" remote
	case "${_target}" in
		remote)
			ask _ip "Production server IP or hostname"
			[[ -n ${_ip} ]] || { echo "IP is required." >&2; exit 1; }
			ask _user "SSH login" root
			read -r -s -p "SSH password (empty = use an SSH key): " _password
			echo
			ask _sshPort "SSH port" 22
			[[ ${_sshPort} =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "SSH port must be a number." >&2; exit 1; }
			_defaultFolder=${_site}
			;;
		local)
			ask _localPath "Local production folder (absolute path)" "${_siteRoot}/_prod"
			[[ ${_localPath} == /* ]] || { echo "The path must be absolute." >&2; exit 1; }
			_defaultFolder=prod-${_site}
			;;
		windows)
			echo "The IIS site and its folder must already exist on the Windows server."
			ask _smbShare 'Folder of the IIS site (e.g. //server/share/site-folder)'
			ask _smbUser "SMB username" Administrator
			read -r -s -p "SMB password: " _smbPassword
			echo
			ask _smbDomain "SMB domain (empty = the server is not on a domain)"
			;;
		*)
			echo "Target must be remote, local or windows." >&2
			exit 1
			;;
	esac
	if [[ ${_target} == windows ]]; then
		ask _prodBinding "Production binding (the domain of the IIS site)" "${_binding}"
		_prodFolder=${_prodBinding}
	else
		ask _prodFolder "Production site name (folder /var/www/<name>, service and Apache config)" "${_defaultFolder}"
		ask _prodBinding "Production binding (domain)" "${_prodFolder}"
	fi
	ask _prodEnvironment "Environment (Development/Test/Staging/Production)" Production
	# Follow this site: an HTTP-only site usually has an HTTP-only production site
	_httpsDefault=n
	if grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*SSLEngine[[:space:]]+On([[:space:]]|$)' "/etc/apache2/sites-available/${_site}.conf" 2>/dev/null; then
		_httpsDefault=y
	fi
	if [[ ${_target} == windows ]]; then
		ask _https "Does the IIS site use HTTPS? (y/n)" "${_httpsDefault}"
	else
		ask _https "Use HTTPS? y issues a certificate, n runs on plain HTTP (y/n)" "${_httpsDefault}"
	fi
fi

case "${_prodEnvironment}" in
	Development | Test | Staging | Production) ;;
	*) echo "Environment must be Development, Test, Staging or Production." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
case "${_https,,}" in
	y | yes) _https=y ;;
	n | no) _https=n ;;
	*) echo "HTTPS must be y or n." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[[ ${_target} == remote || ${_target} == local || ${_target} == windows ]] || { echo "Target must be remote, local or windows." >&2; exit 1; }
_prodFolder=$(normalize_dns_name "${_prodFolder}")
_prodBinding=$(normalize_dns_name "${_prodBinding}" binding)
validate_site_name "${_prodFolder}"
validate_binding "${_prodBinding}"
if [[ ${_target} == remote ]]; then
	[[ -n ${_ip} && -n ${_user} && ${_sshPort} =~ ^[0-9]+$ && ${_sshPort} -ge 1 && ${_sshPort} -le 65535 ]] || {
		echo "Remote target requires a host, SSH user and valid SSH port." >&2
		exit 1
	}
elif [[ ${_target} == windows ]]; then
	_smbShare=${_smbShare//\\//}
	_smbShare=${_smbShare%/}
	# A folder below the share is required, so a typo cannot mirror files into the root of a drive.
	if [[ ! ${_smbShare} =~ ^//[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*/[^/]+(/[^/]+)+$ || /${_smbShare}/ == */../* || /${_smbShare}/ == */./* ]]; then
		echo "The folder must look like //server/share/folder." >&2
		exit 1
	fi
	[[ -n ${_smbUser} && -n ${_smbPassword} ]] || { echo "Windows target requires an SMB username and password." >&2; exit 1; }
	[[ ${_smbDomain} =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]*$ ]] || { echo "Invalid SMB domain." >&2; exit 1; }
else
	[[ ${_localPath} == /* ]] || { echo "The local production folder must be an absolute path." >&2; exit 1; }
	if [[ $(normalize_dns_name "${_prodFolder}" unit) == "$(normalize_dns_name "${_site}" unit)" || ${_prodBinding} == "${_binding}" ]]; then
		echo "A local production site needs a different name and binding than this site." >&2
		exit 1
	fi
fi

# The saved settings of the site's other environments, read without running their scripts
_existing=("${_scripts}/publish_prod.sh" "${_scripts}"/targets/*/publish_prod.sh)
for _file in "${_existing[@]}"; do
	[[ -f ${_file} ]] || continue
	(
		PROD_LOCAL_PATH="" PROD_FOLDER="" PROD_TARGET=""
		source <(grep -E '^PROD_[A-Z_]+=' "${_file}")
		[[ ${_target} == local && -n ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH} ]] || exit 0
		if [[ ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH%/} == "${_localPath%/}" || $(normalize_dns_name "${PROD_FOLDER}" unit) == "$(normalize_dns_name "${_prodFolder}" unit)" ]]; then
			echo "Another environment on this server already uses that folder or site name." >&2
			exit 1
		fi
	)
done

# The folder is named after the environment: production, production-2, ...
_targetId=${_prodEnvironment,,}
_number=2
while [[ -e ${_scripts}/targets/${_targetId} ]]; do
	_targetId=${_prodEnvironment,,}-${_number}
	_number=$((_number + 1))
done
_targetFolder=${_scripts}/targets/${_targetId}

echo
echo "Target:   ${_target}${_ip:+ (${_user}@${_ip}:${_sshPort})}${_localPath:+ (${_localPath})}${_smbShare:+ (${_smbUser}@${_smbShare})}"
echo "Site:     ${_prodFolder}"
echo "Binding:  ${_prodBinding}"
echo "Environment: ${_prodEnvironment}"
echo "Protocol: $([[ ${_https} == y ]] && echo HTTPS || echo HTTP)"
if [[ ${VNS_PROD_MODAL:-} != 1 ]]; then
	read -r -p "Create the production scripts? [Y/n]: " _confirm
	[[ ${_confirm:-y} =~ ^[Yy] ]] || { echo "Cancelled."; exit 1; }
fi

_templates=("${_solutionFolder}/csharp/prod-scripts")
[[ ${_kind} != umbraco ]] || _templates+=("${_solutionFolder}/csharp/umbraco/prod-scripts")
if [[ ${_target} == windows ]]; then
	_templates=("${_solutionFolder}/csharp/windows-prod-scripts")
	[[ ${_kind} != umbraco ]] || _templates+=("${_solutionFolder}/csharp/umbraco/windows-prod-scripts")
	# Stop before anything is changed if the share or the login is wrong
	(
		source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/windows_prod.sh"
		PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE=${_smbShare} PROD_SMB_USER=${_smbUser} PROD_SMB_PASSWORD=${_smbPassword} PROD_SMB_DOMAIN=${_smbDomain}
		windows_smb_connect
	)
fi

_q() { printf '%q' "$1"; }
export R_PROD_LOCAL_PATH="$(_q "${_localPath}")" R_PROD_IP="$(_q "${_ip}")" R_PROD_USER="$(_q "${_user}")" \
	R_PROD_PASSWORD="$(_q "${_password}")" R_PROD_SSH_PORT="$(_q "${_sshPort}")" R_PROD_FOLDER="$(_q "${_prodFolder}")" \
	R_PROD_BINDING="$(_q "${_prodBinding}")" R_PROD_ENVIRONMENT="${_prodEnvironment}" R_ADMIN_MAIL="${_adminMail}" \
	R_PROJECT_NAME="${_projectName}" R_PUBLISH_FOLDER="${_publishFolder}" R_SITE="${_site}" \
	R_PROD_HTTPS="${_https}" R_PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE="$(_q "${_smbShare}")" R_PROD_SMB_USER="$(_q "${_smbUser}")" \
	R_PROD_SMB_PASSWORD="$(_q "${_smbPassword}")" R_PROD_SMB_DOMAIN="$(_q "${_smbDomain}")"
unset _password VNS_PROD_PASSWORD _smbPassword VNS_PROD_SMB_PASSWORD

# Render everything first, so a missing template fails before anything is renamed
_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
for _dir in "${_templates[@]}"; do
	for _file in "${_dir}"/*.sh; do
		[[ -f ${_file} ]] || continue
		perl -pe 's/\@([A-Z_]+)\@/exists $ENV{"R_$1"} ? $ENV{"R_$1"} : "\@$1\@"/ge' "${_file}" >"${_tmp}/$(basename "${_file}")"
	done
done
unset R_PROD_PASSWORD R_PROD_SMB_PASSWORD
[[ -f ${_tmp}/publish_prod.sh ]] || { echo "Template publish_prod.sh not found." >&2; exit 1; }

[[ ! -f ${_scripts}/publish.sh ]] || mv "${_scripts}/publish.sh" "${_scripts}/publish_local.sh"
[[ ! -f ${_scripts}/clear_logs.sh ]] || mv "${_scripts}/clear_logs.sh" "${_scripts}/clear_logs_local.sh"
install -d -m 700 "${_scripts}/targets" "${_targetFolder}"
for _file in "${_tmp}"/*.sh; do
	install -m 700 "${_file}" "${_targetFolder}/$(basename "${_file}")"
done

echo "Created in ${_targetFolder}:"
ls -1 "${_targetFolder}" | sed 's/^/  /'

echo "Publish to ${_prodEnvironment}"
bash "${_targetFolder}/publish_prod.sh"
if [[ -f ${_targetFolder}/sync_prod.sh ]]; then
	echo "Sync content to ${_prodEnvironment}"
	bash "${_targetFolder}/sync_prod.sh"
fi
echo "Environment ${_targetId} is ready."
#!/bin/bash

# The project's outdated packages, and an upgrade if wanted.

#!/bin/bash
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cd ..
clear

# Check if dotnet is installed
if ! command -v dotnet &> /dev/null
then
    echo "dotnet SDK not found. Please install it first."
    exit 1
fi

# dotnet-outdated is an apphost that needs DOTNET_ROOT when .NET is not in /usr/share/dotnet
if [[ -z ${DOTNET_ROOT:-} ]]; then
    DOTNET_ROOT=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v dotnet)")")
    export DOTNET_ROOT
fi

echo "Running dotnet outdated..."
_output=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "${_output}"' EXIT
dotnet outdated 2>&1 | tee "${_output}" || true

if grep -q "No outdated dependencies were detected" "${_output}"; then
    echo
    echo "Done."
    exit 0
fi

echo
read -p "Do you want to upgrade the packages? (y/n): " answer

if [[ "$answer" == "y" || "$answer" == "Y" ]]; then
    echo "Running dotnet outdated --upgrade..."
    dotnet outdated --upgrade
    echo "Upgrade completed."
else
    echo "No upgrade performed."
fi

echo
echo "Done."

#!/bin/bash
# Publish this site into its local publish folder and restart the service.
# Usage: publish.sh [Debug|Release]   (default: @BUILD_CONFIG@)
# After create_prod.sh has run this script is called publish_local.sh.
set -euo pipefail
[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || exec sudo "$0" "$@"
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cd ..

_site=@SITE@
_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_publishFolder=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@
_configuration=${1:-@BUILD_CONFIG@}

case "${_configuration}" in
	Debug | Release) ;;
	*) echo "Usage: $0 [Debug|Release]" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

_stopped=0
start_service() {
	if ((_stopped)); then
		_stopped=0
		systemctl start "${_site}"
	fi
}
# Always bring the site back up, also if the publish fails
trap start_service EXIT

echo "Stop ${_site}"
systemctl stop "${_site}"
_stopped=1

echo "Publish (${_configuration})"
dotnet publish "${_projectName}.csproj" -c "${_configuration}" -p:PublishDir="${_publishFolder}" --self-contained false --nologo

echo "Delete bin"
rm -rf bin

if grep -qs "Umbraco.Cms" ./*.csproj; then
	echo "Delete Umbraco schema files and App_Plugins"
	rm -f appsettings-schema.json appsettings-schema.usync.json appsettings-schema.Umbraco.Cms.json umbraco-package-schema.json
	rm -f "${_publishFolder}"/{appsettings-schema.json,appsettings-schema.usync.json,appsettings-schema.Umbraco.Cms.json,umbraco-package-schema.json}
	rm -rf App_Plugins
fi

chown -R www-data:www-data "${_publishFolder}"
start_service

sleep 2
systemctl status "${_site}" --no-pager || true
if systemctl is-active --quiet "${_site}"; then
	echo "OK: ${_site} is running"
else
	echo "FAILED: ${_site} is not running. Last log lines:"
	journalctl -u "${_site}" -n 20 --no-pager
	exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash
# Publish this C# site (Release) and upload it to a production server over SSH,
# or into a local folder when PROD_LOCAL_PATH is set (e.g. a second copy of the site on this server).
# The Release build goes to a temporary folder, so the test publish in _Publish is left untouched.
# Creates the folder, systemd service, Apache config and certificate on the target if they are missing.
# Requirements on prod: VNS.Linux apache/init.sh has been run, and the login is root or has passwordless sudo.
# DNS for PROD_BINDING must point to the target server before the certificate can be issued.
# With PROD_LOCAL_PATH use a PROD_FOLDER, PROD_BINDING and port that differ from this test site.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cd ..
set -euo pipefail

# ---- Production settings --------------------------------------------------
PROD_LOCAL_PATH=""               # Optional: publish to this local folder (e.g. /var/www/_Prod) instead of a remote server
PROD_IP=""                      # IP or hostname of the production server
PROD_USER="root"                # SSH login
PROD_PASSWORD=""                # SSH password (needs sshpass). Leave empty to use an SSH key
PROD_SSH_PORT=22
PROD_FOLDER="@SITE@"            # Folder name on prod (/var/www/<folder>)
PROD_BINDING="@BINDING@"        # Public domain on prod, e.g. account.vns.dk
PROD_PORT_HTTP=$((@PORT_HTTP@ + 2000))   # Local Kestrel port on prod: test port + 2000, so it cannot clash with sites created locally on prod
PROD_ENVIRONMENT="Production"
PROD_ADMIN_MAIL="@ADMIN_MAIL@"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_publishFolder=$(mktemp -d)
_cleanup=("${_publishFolder}")
trap 'rm -rf "${_cleanup[@]}"' EXIT
_local=0
[[ -n ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH} ]] && _local=1
if ((_local)); then
	_root=${PROD_LOCAL_PATH%/}
	_sudo=""
	[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || _sudo="sudo"
else
	_root=/var/www/${PROD_FOLDER}
fi

_rsyncShell=""
_rsyncPath=""
if [[ -z ${PROD_FOLDER} || -z ${PROD_BINDING} ]]; then
	echo "Set PROD_FOLDER and PROD_BINDING at the top of this script" >&2
	exit 1
fi
if ((! _local)); then
	if [[ -z ${PROD_IP} || -z ${PROD_USER} ]]; then
		echo "Set PROD_IP and PROD_USER (or PROD_LOCAL_PATH) at the top of this script" >&2
		exit 1
	fi

	_ssh=(ssh -p "${PROD_SSH_PORT}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new)
	if [[ -n ${PROD_PASSWORD} ]]; then
		command -v sshpass >/dev/null || { echo "sshpass is required for password login: sudo apt install sshpass" >&2; exit 1; }
		export SSHPASS=${PROD_PASSWORD}
		_ssh=(sshpass -e "${_ssh[@]}")
	fi
	_target=${PROD_USER}@${PROD_IP}
	_sudo=""
	[[ ${PROD_USER} == root ]] || _sudo="sudo -n"
	_rsyncShell="${_ssh[*]}"
	_rsyncPath="${_sudo:+${_sudo} }rsync"
fi

remote() { "${_ssh[@]}" "${_target}" "$@"; }

# Run the script from stdin as root on the target (this machine in local mode)
run_script() {
	if ((_local)); then
		${_sudo} env ${_vars} bash -s
	else
		remote "${_sudo} env ${_vars} bash -s"
	fi
}

# A local target inside the project folder must be excluded from the build, or its files are compiled/included
if ((_local)); then
	_projectDir=$(pwd -P)
	_target_abs=$(realpath -m "${PROD_LOCAL_PATH}")
	if [[ ${_target_abs} == "${_projectDir}"/* ]]; then
		_rel=${_target_abs#"${_projectDir}"/}
		_csproj=${_projectDir}/${_projectName}.csproj
		[[ -f ${_csproj} ]] || _csproj=$(ls "${_projectDir}"/*.csproj | head -n 1)
		if ! grep -qF "Compile Remove=\"${_rel}/**\"" "${_csproj}"; then
			echo "Exclude ${_rel} from the build in $(basename "${_csproj}")"
			perl -0pi -e 's|</Project>\s*$|  <!-- Exclude local prod publish folder from build -->\n  <ItemGroup>\n    <Content Remove="'"${_rel}"'/**" />\n    <Compile Remove="'"${_rel}"'/**" />\n    <None Remove="'"${_rel}"'/**" />\n  </ItemGroup>\n</Project>\n|' "${_csproj}"
		fi
	fi
fi

echo "Publish (Release)"
dotnet publish -c Release -p:PublishDir="${_publishFolder}" --self-contained false --nologo
if [[ ! -f ${_publishFolder}/${_projectName}.dll ]]; then
	echo "Publish failed: ${_projectName}.dll not found in the output" >&2
	exit 1
fi

_umbraco=0
[[ -f ${_publishFolder}/Umbraco.Cms.Core.dll ]] && _umbraco=1

data.pop("ConnectionStrings", None)
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:

# With HTTPS, DNS for PROD_BINDING must point to the target server before the certificate can be issued.

_self=$(realpath "$0")

fi

PROD_HTTPS=@PROD_HTTPS@             # n = plain HTTP without a certificate. Read when the Apache config is created

PROD_ADMIN_MAIL="@ADMIN_MAIL@"

	systemctl daemon-reload

if [[ -z ${_migrateOnly} ]]; then
if ((_local)); then
	echo "Publish to local folder ${_root}"

#!/bin/bash

# With HTTPS, DNS for PROD_BINDING must point to the target server before the certificate can be issued.

_self=$(realpath "$0")
_scriptFolder=$(dirname "${_self}")

_scope=prod
[[ ${_scriptFolder} != */scripts/targets/* ]] || _scope=target-${_scriptFolder##*/}
if [[ ${VNS_PUBLISH_TRACKED:-} != "${_scope}" ]]; then

fi

source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/dotnet.sh"

PROD_LOCAL_PATH=@PROD_LOCAL_PATH@   # If set: publish to this local folder on this server instead of a remote server
PROD_IP=@PROD_IP@                   # IP or hostname of the production server
PROD_USER=@PROD_USER@               # SSH login
PROD_PASSWORD=@PROD_PASSWORD@       # SSH password (needs sshpass). Empty = use an SSH key
PROD_SSH_PORT=@PROD_SSH_PORT@
PROD_FOLDER=@PROD_FOLDER@           # Site name on prod: folder /var/www/<folder>, service and Apache config
PROD_BINDING=@PROD_BINDING@         # Public domain on prod, e.g. account.vns.dk
PROD_HTTPS=@PROD_HTTPS@             # n = plain HTTP without a certificate. Read when the Apache config is created
PROD_ENVIRONMENT="@PROD_ENVIRONMENT@"
PROD_ADMIN_MAIL="@ADMIN_MAIL@"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_localPublish=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@   # The site's local publish folder: source of appsettings*.json on the first publish
_publishFolder=$(mktemp -d)
_cleanup=("${_publishFolder}")
trap 'rm -rf "${_cleanup[@]}"' EXIT
_local=0
[[ -n ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH} ]] && _local=1
if ((_local)); then

_rsyncShell=""
_rsyncPath=""

# With HTTPS, DNS for PROD_BINDING must point to the target server before the certificate can be issued.
# With PROD_LOCAL_PATH use a PROD_FOLDER and PROD_BINDING that differ from the site it is published from.
_self=$(realpath "$0")
_scriptFolder=$(dirname "${_self}")
_siteFolder=${_scriptFolder%/scripts*}   # scripts/ or scripts/targets/<environment>/
_scope=prod
[[ ${_scriptFolder} != */scripts/targets/* ]] || _scope=target-${_scriptFolder##*/}
if [[ ${VNS_PUBLISH_TRACKED:-} != "${_scope}" ]]; then
	exec python3 "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/publish_status.py" run "${_siteFolder}" "${_scope}" /bin/bash "${_self}" "$@"
fi

set -euo pipefail
source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/dotnet.sh"

# ---- Production settings (filled in by create_prod.sh, edit if needed) -----
PROD_LOCAL_PATH=@PROD_LOCAL_PATH@   # If set: publish to this local folder on this server instead of a remote server
PROD_IP=@PROD_IP@                   # IP or hostname of the production server
PROD_USER=@PROD_USER@               # SSH login
PROD_PASSWORD=@PROD_PASSWORD@       # SSH password (needs sshpass). Empty = use an SSH key
PROD_SSH_PORT=@PROD_SSH_PORT@
PROD_FOLDER=@PROD_FOLDER@           # Site name on prod: folder /var/www/<folder>, service and Apache config
PROD_BINDING=@PROD_BINDING@         # Public domain on prod, e.g. account.vns.dk
PROD_HTTPS=@PROD_HTTPS@             # n = plain HTTP without a certificate. Read when the Apache config is created
PROD_ENVIRONMENT="@PROD_ENVIRONMENT@"
PROD_ADMIN_MAIL="@ADMIN_MAIL@"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_localPublish=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@   # The site's local publish folder: source of appsettings*.json on the first publish
_publishFolder=$(mktemp -d)
_cleanup=("${_publishFolder}")
trap 'rm -rf "${_cleanup[@]}"' EXIT
_local=0
[[ -n ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH} ]] && _local=1
if ((_local)); then
	_root=${PROD_LOCAL_PATH%/}
	_sudo=""
	[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || _sudo="sudo"
else
	_root=/var/www/${PROD_FOLDER}
fi

_rsyncShell=""
_rsyncPath=""
if [[ -z ${PROD_FOLDER} || -z ${PROD_BINDING} ]]; then
	echo "Set PROD_FOLDER and PROD_BINDING at the top of this script" >&2
	exit 1
fi
if ((! _local)); then
	if [[ -z ${PROD_IP} || -z ${PROD_USER} ]]; then
		echo "Set PROD_IP and PROD_USER (or PROD_LOCAL_PATH) at the top of this script" >&2

	if [[ -n ${PROD_PASSWORD} ]]; then
		command -v sshpass >/dev/null || { echo "sshpass is required for password login: sudo apt install sshpass" >&2; exit 1; }
		export SSHPASS=${PROD_PASSWORD}

	fi
	_target=${PROD_USER}@${PROD_IP}
	_sudo=""
	[[ ${PROD_USER} == root ]] || _sudo="sudo -n"
	_rsyncShell="${_ssh[*]}"
	_rsyncPath="${_sudo:+${_sudo} }rsync"
fi

remote() { "${_ssh[@]}" "${_target}" "$@"; }
if ((_local)); then
	_runtimeIdentifier=$(linux_runtime_identifier)
else
	_runtimeIdentifier=$(linux_runtime_identifier "$(remote uname -m)")
fi

# Run the script from stdin as root on the target (this machine in local mode)
run_script() {

# A local target inside the project folder must be excluded from the build, or its files are compiled/included

		fi
	fi

	exit 1

grep -qs "Umbraco.Cms" ./*.csproj && _umbraco=1

set -euo pipefail
source /vns/apache/lib/common.sh
unit=$(normalize_dns_name "${SITE}" unit)
root=${ROOT}
docroot=${root}/wwwroot
conf=/etc/apache2/sites-available/${SITE}.conf
service=/etc/systemd/system/${unit}.service

source /vns/apache/lib/common.sh

fi

if [[ ! -e ${service} ]]; then

	cat >"${service}" <<EOF

Description=Running .NET Core [${SITE}]

[Service]
User=www-data
Group=www-data
WorkingDirectory=${root}
ExecStart=/usr/lib/dotnet/dotnet ${root}/${PROJECT}.dll --urls "http://localhost:${PORT}"
RestartSec=10
Restart=always
KillSignal=SIGINT

StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=${SITE}

Environment=DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=${ENVIRONMENT}
Environment=ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true

ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
RootDirectory=/var/lib/vns-roots/${SITE}
BindReadOnlyPaths=/usr/lib/dotnet /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /lib64 /usr/lib/ssl -/usr/share/zoneinfo -/usr/share/ca-certificates /etc/ssl /etc/ld.so.cache /etc/resolv.conf /etc/hosts /etc/nsswitch.conf /etc/passwd /etc/group /etc/localtime /etc/os-release

ReadWritePaths=${root}

WantedBy=multi-user.target

	systemctl daemon-reload
	systemctl enable "${unit}"
fi

server_aliases=()
if [[ -f ${conf} ]]; then
	while IFS= read -r alias; do
		[[ -n ${alias} ]] || continue
		alias=${alias,,}
		[[ ${alias} =~ ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$ && ${#alias} -le 253 ]] || {
			echo "Invalid ServerAlias '${alias}' in ${conf}; certificate issuance stopped." >&2
			exit 1

		((found)) || server_aliases+=("${alias}")
	done < <(awk '$1 == "ServerAlias" { for (i = 2; i <= NF && $i !~ /^#/; i++) print $i }' "${conf}")
fi
server_alias_line=""
if ((${#server_aliases[@]})); then
	printf -v server_alias_line '  ServerAlias %s' "${server_aliases[*]}"
fi

	printf 'Issue certificate for: %s\n' "${certificate_domains[*]}"
	cat >"${conf}" <<EOF
<VirtualHost *:80>
  ServerAdmin ${MAIL}
  ServerName ${BINDING}
${server_alias_line}
  DocumentRoot ${docroot}
  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-80-error.log
  <Directory ${docroot}>
    AllowOverride All
    Require all granted
  </Directory>
</VirtualHost>

	systemctl reload apache2

	for c in /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/*.conf; do

fi

extra=""

  ProxyPassReverse /robots.txt http://localhost:${PORT}/seo_robots_txt

  ServerName ${BINDING}

  DocumentRoot ${docroot}

  AllowEncodedSlashes NoDecode

  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteCond %{HTTP:Upgrade} =websocket [NC]
  RewriteCond %{HTTP:Connection} upgrade [NC]
  RewriteRule /(.*) ws://localhost:${PORT}/\$1 [P,L]

  ProxyRequests Off
  ProxyPass /.well-known/acme-challenge/ !
  RequestHeader set X-Forwarded-Proto "http"

  ProxyPass / http://localhost:${PORT}/ nocanon
  ProxyPassReverse / http://localhost:${PORT}/

  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-80-error.log

	fi
elif ! grep -q "SSLEngine" "${conf}" 2>/dev/null; then
	echo "Create Apache config"
	cat >"${conf}" <<EOF
<VirtualHost *:80>
  ServerAdmin ${MAIL}
  ServerName ${BINDING}
${server_alias_line}
  DocumentRoot ${docroot}

  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/\.well-known/acme-challenge/
  RewriteRule ^(.*)\$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]

  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-rewrite-error.log
</VirtualHost>

<VirtualHost *:443>
  ServerAdmin ${MAIL}
  ServerName ${BINDING}
${server_alias_line}
  DocumentRoot ${docroot}

  AllowEncodedSlashes NoDecode

  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteCond %{HTTP:Upgrade} =websocket [NC]

  RewriteRule /(.*) ws://localhost:${PORT}/\$1 [P,L]

  ProxyRequests Off
  RequestHeader set X-Forwarded-Proto "https"

  ProxyPass / http://localhost:${PORT}/ nocanon
  ProxyPassReverse / http://localhost:${PORT}/

  SSLCertificateKeyFile ${certdir}/${BINDING}.key

  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-443-error.log

fi

systemctl reload apache2
release_port_reservation

	_dest="${_target}:${_root}/"

# Is this the first publish? Decided before anything is copied.
_exists=0
if { ((_local)) && [[ -f ${_root}/appsettings.json ]]; } || { ((! _local)) && remote "${_sudo} test -f '${_root}/appsettings.json'"; }; then
	_exists=1
fi

# Schema files are never uploaded. Once the site exists on the target, its content, settings and data are never
# overwritten or deleted by a publish (rsync keeps excluded paths when using --delete).
_keep=(--exclude 'appsettings-schema*.json' --exclude 'umbraco-package-schema.json')
if ((_exists)); then

		--exclude '/umbraco/' --exclude '/uSync/' --exclude '/Views/' --exclude '/wwwroot/'
		--exclude '/App_Data/' --exclude '/app_data/')
fi
rsync -az --delete "${_keep[@]}" ${_rsyncRemote[@]+"${_rsyncRemote[@]}"} "${_publishFolder}/" "${_dest}"

if ((_exists)); then
	echo "appsettings.json already exists in the destination - not touched"
else

	for _file in "${_first}"/appsettings*.json; do

		if command -v python3 >/dev/null; then
			python3 - "${_file}" <<'PY'

path = sys.argv[1]
with open(path, encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
data.pop("ConnectionStrings", None)
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    f.write("\n")
PY
		elif command -v jq >/dev/null; then

		else
			echo "python3 or jq is required to remove ConnectionStrings" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
	done
	rsync -az ${_rsyncRemote[@]+"${_rsyncRemote[@]}"} "${_first}/" "${_dest}"
fi

run_script <<'REMOTE'

chown -R www-data:www-data "${dir}"
python3 /vns/apache/lib/sql_startup.py "${SITE}"
systemctl start "$(python3 /vns/apache/lib/domain_names.py "${SITE}" unit)"
sleep 2
systemctl status "$(python3 /vns/apache/lib/domain_names.py "${SITE}" unit)" --no-pager

echo "Delete schema files and bin"
rm -f appsettings-schema.json
rm -f appsettings-schema.usync.json
rm -f appsettings-schema.Umbraco.Cms.json

		if ! grep -qF "Compile Remove=\"${_rel}/**\"" "${_csproj}"; then

			perl -0pi -e 's|</Project>\s*$|  <!-- Exclude local prod publish folder from build -->\n  <ItemGroup>\n    <Content Remove="'"${_rel}"'/**" />\n    <Compile Remove="'"${_rel}"'/**" />\n    <None Remove="'"${_rel}"'/**" />\n  </ItemGroup>\n</Project>\n|' "${_csproj}"

_vars="SITE='${PROD_FOLDER}' BINDING='${PROD_BINDING}' ENVIRONMENT='${PROD_ENVIRONMENT}' MAIL='${PROD_ADMIN_MAIL}' PROJECT='${_projectName}' UMBRACO='${_umbraco}' ROOT='${_root}' HTTPS='${PROD_HTTPS}'"

echo "Prepare ${PROD_FOLDER} on ${PROD_IP:-this server}"
run_script <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
source /vns/apache/lib/common.sh
unit=$(normalize_dns_name "${SITE}" unit)
root=${ROOT}
docroot=${root}/wwwroot
conf=/etc/apache2/sites-available/${SITE}.conf
service=/etc/systemd/system/${unit}.service
certdir=/etc/ssl/certs/${BINDING}_ecc
acme=/etc/acmesh/acme.sh
source /vns/apache/lib/common.sh

if [[ -e ${service} ]] && ! grep -qx "WorkingDirectory=${root}" "${service}"; then
	echo "Service ${SITE} already exists and runs from a different folder. Use another PROD_FOLDER (and PROD_BINDING)." >&2
	exit 1

PORT=""
if [[ -e ${service} ]]; then
	PORT=$(grep '^ExecStart=' "${service}" | grep -oE '(localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|\*):[0-9]+' | head -n 1 | cut -d: -f2 || true)

elif [[ -e ${conf} ]]; then
	PORT=$(grep -hEo '(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost|\*):[0-9]{1,5}' "${conf}" | head -n 1 | cut -d: -f2)

if [[ -z ${PORT} ]]; then

mkdir -p "${docroot}" "/var/lib/vns-roots/${SITE}"

if [[ ! -e ${service} ]]; then
	echo "Create service"
	cat >"${service}" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Running .NET Core [${SITE}]

[Service]
User=www-data
Group=www-data
WorkingDirectory=${root}
ExecStart=/usr/lib/dotnet/dotnet ${root}/${PROJECT}.dll --urls "http://localhost:${PORT}"
RestartSec=10
Restart=always
KillSignal=SIGINT
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=${SITE}
Environment=ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=${ENVIRONMENT}
Environment=DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=${ENVIRONMENT}
Environment=ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
RootDirectory=/var/lib/vns-roots/${SITE}
BindReadOnlyPaths=/usr/lib/dotnet /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /lib64 /usr/lib/ssl -/usr/share/zoneinfo -/usr/share/ca-certificates /etc/ssl /etc/ld.so.cache /etc/resolv.conf /etc/hosts /etc/nsswitch.conf /etc/passwd /etc/group /etc/localtime /etc/os-release

MountAPIVFS=yes
ReadWritePaths=${root}

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
	systemctl daemon-reload
	systemctl enable "${unit}"
fi

server_aliases=()
if [[ -f ${conf} ]]; then
	while IFS= read -r alias; do
		[[ -n ${alias} ]] || continue
		alias=${alias,,}
		[[ ${alias} =~ ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$ && ${#alias} -le 253 ]] || {
			echo "Invalid ServerAlias '${alias}' in ${conf}; certificate issuance stopped." >&2
			exit 1
		}
		found=0
		for domain in "${BINDING}" "${server_aliases[@]}"; do [[ ${domain} == "${alias}" ]] && found=1; done
		((found)) || server_aliases+=("${alias}")
	done < <(awk '$1 == "ServerAlias" { for (i = 2; i <= NF && $i !~ /^#/; i++) print $i }' "${conf}")
fi
server_alias_line=""
if ((${#server_aliases[@]})); then
	printf -v server_alias_line '  ServerAlias %s' "${server_aliases[*]}"
fi

if [[ ${HTTPS} != n && ! -e ${certdir}/fullchain.cer ]]; then
	[[ -x ${acme} ]] || { echo "acme.sh not found on prod (${acme}). Run apache/init.sh there first." >&2; exit 1; }
	certificate_domains=("${BINDING}" "${server_aliases[@]}")
	certificate_args=()
	for domain in "${certificate_domains[@]}"; do certificate_args+=(-d "${domain}"); done
	printf 'Issue certificate for: %s\n' "${certificate_domains[*]}"
	cat >"${conf}" <<EOF
<VirtualHost *:80>
  ServerAdmin ${MAIL}
  ServerName ${BINDING}
${server_alias_line}
  DocumentRoot ${docroot}
  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-80-error.log
  <Directory ${docroot}>
    AllowOverride All
    Require all granted
  </Directory>
</VirtualHost>
EOF
	a2enmod ssl proxy proxy_http proxy_wstunnel rewrite headers >/dev/null
	[[ -e /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/${SITE}.conf ]] || a2ensite "${SITE}.conf" >/dev/null
	apache2ctl configtest
	systemctl reload apache2
	# Leftover acme data for this domain (e.g. from a deleted site) makes --issue fail with "Domain key exists"
	used=0
	for c in /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/*.conf; do
		[[ -e ${c} && ${c} != "/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/${SITE}.conf" ]] || continue
		awk -v d="${BINDING}" '($1 == "ServerName" || $1 == "ServerAlias") { for (i = 2; i <= NF; i++) if (tolower($i) == tolower(d)) f = 1 } END { exit !f }' "${c}" && used=1
	done
	if [[ ${used} == 0 ]]; then
		"${acme}" --remove -d "${BINDING}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
		rm -rf "/etc/ssl/certs/${BINDING}" "/etc/ssl/certs/${BINDING}_ecc"
	fi
	rc=0
	"${acme}" --issue --apache --force --server letsencrypt "${certificate_args[@]}" || rc=$?
	if [[ ${rc} -ne 0 && ${rc} -ne 2 ]]; then
		echo "Certificate issue failed. Check that DNS for ${BINDING} points to this server." >&2
		exit 1
	fi
	mkdir -p "${certdir}"
	"${acme}" --install-cert -d "${BINDING}" --key-file "${certdir}/${BINDING}.key" \
		--fullchain-file "${certdir}/fullchain.cer" --reloadcmd "systemctl reload apache2"
fi

extra=""

	extra="
  ProxyPass /robots.txt http://localhost:${PORT}/seo_robots_txt
  ProxyPassReverse /robots.txt http://localhost:${PORT}/seo_robots_txt

  ProxyPass /sitemap.xml http://localhost:${PORT}/seo_sitemap_xml
  ProxyPassReverse /sitemap.xml http://localhost:${PORT}/seo_sitemap_xml
"
fi

	if ! grep -q "ProxyPass" "${conf}" 2>/dev/null; then

		cat >"${conf}" <<EOF
<VirtualHost *:80>
  ServerAdmin ${MAIL}
  ServerName ${BINDING}
${server_alias_line}
  DocumentRoot ${docroot}

  AllowEncodedSlashes NoDecode

  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteCond %{HTTP:Upgrade} =websocket [NC]
  RewriteCond %{HTTP:Connection} upgrade [NC]
  RewriteRule /(.*) ws://localhost:${PORT}/\$1 [P,L]

  ProxyPreserveHost On
  ProxyRequests Off
  ProxyPass /.well-known/acme-challenge/ !
  RequestHeader set X-Forwarded-Proto "http"
${extra}
  ProxyPass / http://localhost:${PORT}/ nocanon
  ProxyPassReverse / http://localhost:${PORT}/

  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-80-error.log
</VirtualHost>
EOF
	fi
elif ! grep -q "SSLEngine" "${conf}" 2>/dev/null; then

<VirtualHost *:80>
  ServerAdmin ${MAIL}
  ServerName ${BINDING}
${server_alias_line}
  DocumentRoot ${docroot}

  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/\.well-known/acme-challenge/
  RewriteRule ^(.*)\$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]

  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-rewrite-error.log
</VirtualHost>

<VirtualHost *:443>
  ServerAdmin ${MAIL}
  ServerName ${BINDING}
${server_alias_line}
  DocumentRoot ${docroot}

  AllowEncodedSlashes NoDecode

  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteCond %{HTTP:Upgrade} =websocket [NC]

  RewriteRule /(.*) ws://localhost:${PORT}/\$1 [P,L]

  ProxyPreserveHost On
  ProxyRequests Off
  RequestHeader set X-Forwarded-Proto "https"
${extra}
  ProxyPass / http://localhost:${PORT}/ nocanon
  ProxyPassReverse / http://localhost:${PORT}/

  SSLEngine On

  SSLCertificateFile ${certdir}/fullchain.cer
  SSLCertificateKeyFile ${certdir}/${BINDING}.key

  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-443-error.log
</VirtualHost>
EOF
fi

[[ -e /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/${SITE}.conf ]] || a2ensite "${SITE}.conf" >/dev/null

else

	_dest="${_target}:${_root}/"

fi

# Is this the first publish? Decided before anything is copied.
_exists=0
if { ((_local)) && [[ -f ${_root}/appsettings.json ]]; } || { ((! _local)) && remote "${_sudo} test -f '${_root}/appsettings.json'"; }; then
	_exists=1
fi

# Schema files are never uploaded. Once the site exists on the target, its content, settings and data are never
# overwritten or deleted by a publish (rsync keeps excluded paths when using --delete).
_keep=(--exclude 'appsettings-schema*.json' --exclude 'umbraco-package-schema.json')
if ((_exists)); then
	_keep+=(--exclude 'appsettings*.json'
		--exclude '/umbraco/' --exclude '/uSync/' --exclude '/Views/' --exclude '/wwwroot/'
		--exclude '/App_Data/' --exclude '/app_data/')
fi
rsync -az --delete "${_keep[@]}" ${_rsyncRemote[@]+"${_rsyncRemote[@]}"} "${_publishFolder}/" "${_dest}"

if ((_exists)); then
	echo "appsettings.json already exists in the destination - not touched"
else
	echo "First publish: copy appsettings*.json (without ConnectionStrings)"
	_first=$(mktemp -d)
	_cleanup+=("${_first}")
	# Prefer the files from the local publish folder (created by create_site.sh); fall back to the fresh build
	for _src in "${_localPublish}" "${_publishFolder}"; do
		cp "${_src}"/appsettings*.json "${_first}/" 2>/dev/null || true
		[[ -f ${_first}/appsettings.json ]] && break
	done
	rm -f "${_first}"/appsettings-schema*.json
	for _file in "${_first}"/appsettings*.json; do
		[[ -f ${_file} ]] || continue
		if command -v python3 >/dev/null; then
			python3 - "${_file}" <<'PY'
import json, sys
path = sys.argv[1]
with open(path, encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    data = json.load(f)
data.pop("ConnectionStrings", None)
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    f.write("\n")
PY
		elif command -v jq >/dev/null; then
			jq 'del(.ConnectionStrings)' "${_file}" >"${_file}.new" && mv "${_file}.new" "${_file}"
		else
			echo "python3 or jq is required to remove ConnectionStrings" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
	done
	rsync -az ${_rsyncRemote[@]+"${_rsyncRemote[@]}"} "${_first}/" "${_dest}"
fi

dir=${ROOT}
file=${dir}/appsettings.json

scheme=http
use_https=false

# Publish this C# site (always a Release build) and upload it to a production server over SSH,
# or into a local folder when PROD_LOCAL_PATH is set (e.g. a second copy of the site on this server).
# The Release build goes to a temporary folder, so the local publish folder is left untouched.
# Creates the folder, systemd service, Apache config and certificate on the target if they are missing.
# Requirements on prod: VNS.Linux apache/init.sh has been run, and the login is root or has passwordless sudo.
# DNS for PROD_BINDING must point to the target server before the certificate can be issued.
# With PROD_LOCAL_PATH use a PROD_FOLDER and PROD_BINDING that differ from the site it is published from.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cd ..
set -euo pipefail

# ---- Production settings (filled in by create_prod.sh, edit if needed) -----
PROD_LOCAL_PATH=@PROD_LOCAL_PATH@   # If set: publish to this local folder on this server instead of a remote server
PROD_IP=@PROD_IP@                   # IP or hostname of the production server
PROD_USER=@PROD_USER@               # SSH login
PROD_PASSWORD=@PROD_PASSWORD@       # SSH password (needs sshpass). Empty = use an SSH key
PROD_SSH_PORT=@PROD_SSH_PORT@
PROD_FOLDER=@PROD_FOLDER@           # Site name on prod: folder /var/www/<folder>, service and Apache config
PROD_BINDING=@PROD_BINDING@         # Public domain on prod, e.g. account.vns.dk
PROD_ENVIRONMENT="@PROD_ENVIRONMENT@"
PROD_ADMIN_MAIL="@ADMIN_MAIL@"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_localPublish=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@   # The site's local publish folder: source of appsettings*.json and web.config on the first publish
_publishFolder=$(mktemp -d)
_cleanup=("${_publishFolder}")
trap 'rm -rf "${_cleanup[@]}"' EXIT
_local=0
[[ -n ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH} ]] && _local=1
if ((_local)); then
	_root=${PROD_LOCAL_PATH%/}
	_sudo=""
	[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || _sudo="sudo"
else
	_root=/var/www/${PROD_FOLDER}
fi

_rsyncShell=""
_rsyncPath=""
if [[ -z ${PROD_FOLDER} || -z ${PROD_BINDING} ]]; then
	echo "Set PROD_FOLDER and PROD_BINDING at the top of this script" >&2
	exit 1
fi
if ((! _local)); then
	if [[ -z ${PROD_IP} || -z ${PROD_USER} ]]; then
		echo "Set PROD_IP and PROD_USER (or PROD_LOCAL_PATH) at the top of this script" >&2
		exit 1
	fi

	_ssh=(ssh -p "${PROD_SSH_PORT}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new)
	if [[ -n ${PROD_PASSWORD} ]]; then
		command -v sshpass >/dev/null || { echo "sshpass is required for password login: sudo apt install sshpass" >&2; exit 1; }
		export SSHPASS=${PROD_PASSWORD}
		_ssh=(sshpass -e "${_ssh[@]}")
	fi
	_target=${PROD_USER}@${PROD_IP}
	_sudo=""
	[[ ${PROD_USER} == root ]] || _sudo="sudo -n"
	_rsyncShell="${_ssh[*]}"
	_rsyncPath="${_sudo:+${_sudo} }rsync"
fi

remote() { "${_ssh[@]}" "${_target}" "$@"; }

# Run the script from stdin as root on the target (this machine in local mode)
run_script() {
	if ((_local)); then
		${_sudo} bash -c "env ${_vars} bash -s"
	else
		remote "${_sudo} env ${_vars} bash -s"
	fi
}

# A local target inside the project folder must be excluded from the build, or its files are compiled/included
if ((_local)); then
	_projectDir=$(pwd -P)
	_target_abs=$(realpath -m "${PROD_LOCAL_PATH}")
	if [[ ${_target_abs} == "${_projectDir}"/* ]]; then
		_rel=${_target_abs#"${_projectDir}"/}
		_csproj=${_projectDir}/${_projectName}.csproj
		[[ -f ${_csproj} ]] || _csproj=$(ls "${_projectDir}"/*.csproj | head -n 1)
		if ! grep -qF "Compile Remove=\"${_rel}/**\"" "${_csproj}"; then
			echo "Exclude ${_rel} from the build in $(basename "${_csproj}")"
			perl -0pi -e 's|</Project>\s*$|  <!-- Exclude local prod publish folder from build -->\n  <ItemGroup>\n    <Content Remove="'"${_rel}"'/**" />\n    <Compile Remove="'"${_rel}"'/**" />\n    <None Remove="'"${_rel}"'/**" />\n  </ItemGroup>\n</Project>\n|' "${_csproj}"
		fi
	fi
fi

echo "Publish (Release)"
dotnet publish "${_projectName}.csproj" -c Release -p:PublishDir="${_publishFolder}" --self-contained false --nologo
if [[ ! -f ${_publishFolder}/${_projectName}.dll ]]; then

	cat >"${conf}" <<EOF

PROD_SSH_PORT=@PROD_SSH_PORT@
PROD_FOLDER=@PROD_FOLDER@           # Site name on prod: folder /var/www/<folder>, service and Apache config
PROD_BINDING=@PROD_BINDING@         # Public domain on prod, e.g. account.vns.dk
PROD_PORT_HTTP=@PROD_PORT_HTTP@     # Local Kestrel port on prod
PROD_ENVIRONMENT="Production"
PROD_ADMIN_MAIL="@ADMIN_MAIL@"

_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_localPublish=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@   # The site's local publish folder: source of appsettings*.json and web.config on the first publish

# Publish this C# site (always a Release build) and upload it to a production server over SSH,
# or into a local folder when PROD_LOCAL_PATH is set (e.g. a second copy of the site on this server).

cd ..

PROD_PASSWORD=@PROD_PASSWORD@       # SSH password (needs sshpass). Empty = use an SSH key
PROD_SSH_PORT=@PROD_SSH_PORT@
PROD_FOLDER=@PROD_FOLDER@           # Site name on prod: folder /var/www/<folder>, service and Apache config
PROD_BINDING=@PROD_BINDING@         # Public domain on prod, e.g. account.vns.dk
PROD_PORT_HTTP=@PROD_PORT_HTTP@     # Local Kestrel port on prod
PROD_ENVIRONMENT="Production"
PROD_ADMIN_MAIL="@ADMIN_MAIL@"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_localPublish=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@   # The site's local publish folder: source of appsettings*.json and web.config on the first publish
_publishFolder=$(mktemp -d)
_cleanup=("${_publishFolder}")
trap 'rm -rf "${_cleanup[@]}"' EXIT
_local=0
[[ -n ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH} ]] && _local=1
if ((_local)); then
	_root=${PROD_LOCAL_PATH%/}
	_sudo=""
	[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || _sudo="sudo"
else
	_root=/var/www/${PROD_FOLDER}
fi

_rsyncShell=""
_rsyncPath=""
if [[ -z ${PROD_FOLDER} || -z ${PROD_BINDING} ]]; then
	echo "Set PROD_FOLDER and PROD_BINDING at the top of this script" >&2

	_rsyncPath="${_sudo:+${_sudo} }rsync"
fi

remote() { "${_ssh[@]}" "${_target}" "$@"; }

	if ((_local)); then
		${_sudo} bash -c "env ${_vars} bash -s"
	else
		remote "${_sudo} env ${_vars} bash -s"
	fi

# A local target inside the project folder must be excluded from the build, or its files are compiled/included

	_target_abs=$(realpath -m "${PROD_LOCAL_PATH}")

		[[ -f ${_csproj} ]] || _csproj=$(ls "${_projectDir}"/*.csproj | head -n 1)

		fi
	fi

	exit 1

docroot=${root}/wwwroot
conf=/etc/apache2/sites-available/${SITE}.conf
service=/etc/systemd/system/${SITE}.service
certdir=/etc/ssl/certs/${SITE}_ecc

	exit 1
fi

	echo "Stop service"
	systemctl stop "${SITE}" || true
fi

if [[ ! -e ${service} ]]; then
	echo "Create service"
	cat >"${service}" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Running .NET Core [${SITE}]

[Service]
User=www-data
Group=www-data
WorkingDirectory=${root}
ExecStart=/usr/lib/dotnet/dotnet ${root}/${PROJECT}.dll --urls "http://localhost:${PORT}"
RestartSec=10
Restart=always
KillSignal=SIGINT
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=${SITE}
Environment=ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=${ENVIRONMENT}
Environment=DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=${ENVIRONMENT}
Environment=ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
RootDirectory=/var/lib/vns-roots/${SITE}
BindReadOnlyPaths=/usr/lib/dotnet /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /lib64 /usr/lib/ssl -/usr/share/zoneinfo -/usr/share/ca-certificates /etc/ssl /etc/ld.so.cache /etc/resolv.conf /etc/hosts /etc/nsswitch.conf /etc/passwd /etc/group /etc/localtime /etc/os-release
BindPaths=${root}
MountAPIVFS=yes
ReadWritePaths=${root}

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
	systemctl daemon-reload
	systemctl enable "${SITE}"
fi

if [[ ! -e ${certdir}/fullchain.cer ]]; then
	echo "Issue certificate for ${BINDING}"
	[[ -x ${acme} ]] || { echo "acme.sh not found on prod (${acme}). Run apache/init.sh there first." >&2; exit 1; }
	cat >"${conf}" <<EOF
<VirtualHost *:80>
  ServerAdmin ${MAIL}
  ServerName ${BINDING}
  DocumentRoot ${docroot}
  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-80-error.log
  <Directory ${docroot}>
    AllowOverride All
    Require all granted
  </Directory>
</VirtualHost>
EOF
	a2enmod ssl proxy proxy_http proxy_wstunnel rewrite headers >/dev/null
	[[ -e /etc/apache2/sites-enabled/${SITE}.conf ]] || a2ensite "${SITE}.conf" >/dev/null
	apache2ctl configtest
	systemctl reload apache2
	rc=0
	"${acme}" --issue --apache --server letsencrypt -d "${BINDING}" || rc=$?
	if [[ ${rc} -ne 0 && ${rc} -ne 2 ]]; then
		echo "Certificate issue failed. Check that DNS for ${BINDING} points to this server." >&2
		exit 1
	fi
	mkdir -p "${certdir}"
	"${acme}" --install-cert -d "${BINDING}" --key-file "${certdir}/${SITE}.key" \
		--fullchain-file "${certdir}/fullchain.cer" --reloadcmd "systemctl reload apache2"
fi

	if [[ ${UMBRACO} == 1 ]]; then

  ProxyPassReverse /robots.txt http://localhost:${PORT}/seo_robots_txt

  ProxyPassReverse /sitemap.xml http://localhost:${PORT}/seo_sitemap_xml
"
	fi
	cat >"${conf}" <<EOF

  ServerName ${BINDING}
  DocumentRoot ${docroot}

  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/.well-known/acme-challenge/
  RewriteRule ^(.*)\$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L]

  ServerName ${BINDING}

  ProxyRequests Off
  RequestHeader set X-Forwarded-Proto "https"

  ProxyPass / http://localhost:${PORT}/ nocanon
  ProxyPassReverse / http://localhost:${PORT}/

  SSLEngine On

  SSLCertificateKeyFile ${certdir}/${SITE}.key

  ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/${SITE}-443-error.log
</VirtualHost>
EOF

	systemctl reload apache2
fi

_scriptFolder=$(dirname "${_self}")
_siteFolder=${_scriptFolder%/scripts*}   # scripts/ or scripts/targets/<environment>/

	exec python3 "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/publish_status.py" run "${_siteFolder}" "${_scope}" /bin/bash "${_self}" "$@"

source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/windows_prod.sh"

	exit 0

	rclone copyto "${_workDir}/web.config" "${_windowsTarget}/web.config"
fi

# Every file is in place: the site may come back

windows_bring_online

# The first request starts the app, which is why this can take a while.

	echo "WARNING: ${_siteUrl} answered with HTTP ${_httpStatus}. Set the connection string in appsettings.json on the server if the site needs one, and check the IIS binding."
else
	echo "FAILED: ${_siteUrl} answered with HTTP ${_httpStatus}. Check the log on the Windows server." >&2
	exit 1
fi

# Module are installed. Without URL Rewrite, IIS answers HTTP 500.19 to a web.config with rewrite rules.
# Requirements here: rclone 1.60 or newer, curl.
# web.config is created when the server has none, with the HTTPS redirect (HTTPS sites) and the sitemap.xml and
# robots.txt rewrites (Umbraco sites). After the first publish web.config, appsettings*.json and the site's content
# are never overwritten by a publish. Use sync_prod.sh (Umbraco) for content.
# This file contains a password: keep it readable by root only (chmod 700).
[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || exec sudo "$0" "$@"
# A dry run changes nothing, so it must not be recorded as a publish.
_self=$(realpath "$0")
_scriptFolder=$(dirname "${_self}")
_siteFolder=${_scriptFolder%/scripts*}   # scripts/ or scripts/targets/<environment>/
_scope=prod
[[ ${_scriptFolder} != */scripts/targets/* ]] || _scope=target-${_scriptFolder##*/}
if [[ ${VNS_PUBLISH_TRACKED:-} != "${_scope}" && ${1:-} != --dry-run ]]; then
	exec python3 "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/publish_status.py" run "${_siteFolder}" "${_scope}" /bin/bash "${_self}" "$@"
fi
cd "${_siteFolder}"
set -euo pipefail
source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/dotnet.sh"
source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/windows_prod.sh"

# ---- Production settings (filled in by create_prod.sh, edit if needed) -----
PROD_TARGET=windows
PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE=@PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE@   # The IIS site's folder, e.g. //server/share/site-folder
PROD_SMB_USER=@PROD_SMB_USER@
PROD_SMB_PASSWORD=@PROD_SMB_PASSWORD@
PROD_SMB_DOMAIN=@PROD_SMB_DOMAIN@         # Empty if the server is not on a domain
PROD_FOLDER=@PROD_FOLDER@                 # Name of the production site in the admin
PROD_BINDING=@PROD_BINDING@               # The IIS site's domain. The binding itself is managed in IIS
PROD_HTTPS=@PROD_HTTPS@                   # n = the site answers on http://, otherwise https://
PROD_ENVIRONMENT="@PROD_ENVIRONMENT@"     # Written to web.config on the first publish
PROD_OFFLINE_WAIT=5                       # Seconds IIS gets to release its files after app_offline.htm
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_localPublish=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@   # The site's local publish folder: source of appsettings*.json on the first publish
_siteUrl=https://${PROD_BINDING}
[[ ${PROD_HTTPS} != n ]] || _siteUrl=http://${PROD_BINDING}

_dryRun=0
case "${1:-}" in
	"") ;;
	--dry-run) _dryRun=1; echo "DRY RUN: nothing will be changed on the server." ;;
	*) echo "Usage: $0 [--dry-run]" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

_workDir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/publish-windows.XXXXXX)
_publish=${_workDir}/publish

on_exit() {
	local _status=$?
	# Always bring the site back up, also if the publish fails
	windows_bring_online || _status=1
	rm -rf "${_workDir}"
	exit "${_status}"
}
trap on_exit EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT TERM

echo "Check ${PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE}"
windows_smb_connect

# Is this the first publish? Decided before anything is copied.
_listing=$(rclone lsf "${_windowsTarget}" --max-depth 1 --files-only)
_firstPublish=1
if grep -qix 'appsettings.json' <<<"${_listing}"; then _firstPublish=0; fi
_hasWebConfig=0
if grep -qix 'web.config' <<<"${_listing}"; then _hasWebConfig=1; fi

# Built locally first, so the site stays up if the build fails.
echo "Publish (Release, win-x64)"
dotnet publish "${_projectName}.csproj" -c Release -p:PublishDir="${_publish}/" -p:EnvironmentName="${PROD_ENVIRONMENT}" -p:CustomAfterMicrosoftCommonTargets="@APACHE_DIR@/lib/publish.targets" --runtime win-x64 --self-contained false --nologo
if [[ ! -f ${_publish}/${_projectName}.dll ]]; then
	echo "Publish failed: ${_projectName}.dll not found in the output" >&2
	exit 1
fi

echo "Delete schema files and bin"
for _file in appsettings-schema.json appsettings-schema.usync.json appsettings-schema.Umbraco.Cms.json umbraco-package-schema.json; do
	rm -f "${_file}"
done
rm -f "${_publish}"/appsettings-schema*.json "${_publish}/umbraco-package-schema.json"
rm -rf bin

# The project's Linux publish folder must not end up on the Windows server.
if [[ ${_localPublish} != . && -e ${_publish}/${_localPublish} ]]; then
	echo "FAILED: the build output contains ${_localPublish}. Exclude it in the .csproj. Nothing was changed on the server." >&2
	exit 1
fi

if ((_firstPublish)); then
	echo "First publish: prepare appsettings*.json (without ConnectionStrings)"
	# Prefer the files from the local publish folder (created by create_site.sh); fall back to the fresh build
	if [[ -f ${_localPublish}/appsettings.json ]]; then
		rm -f "${_publish}"/appsettings*.json
		cp "${_localPublish}"/appsettings*.json "${_publish}/"
		rm -f "${_publish}"/appsettings-schema*.json
	fi
	for _file in "${_publish}"/appsettings*.json; do
		[[ -f ${_file} ]] || continue
		python3 "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/windows_prod.py" prepare-appsettings "${_file}" "${_siteUrl}" "${PROD_HTTPS}"
	done
fi

# copy, never sync: sync would delete logs and uploaded media on the server.
# Once the site exists, its settings and content are never overwritten by a publish.
_copyOpts=(--create-empty-src-dirs --modify-window 2s --stats 0 -v --ignore-case --exclude '/web.config')
if ((!_firstPublish)); then
	_copyOpts+=(--exclude 'appsettings*.json' --exclude '/umbraco/**' --exclude '/uSync/**' --exclude '/Views/**'
		--exclude '/wwwroot/**' --exclude '/App_Data/**')
fi

if ((!_hasWebConfig)); then
	_webConfigHttps=y
	[[ ${PROD_HTTPS} != n ]] || _webConfigHttps=n
	_webConfigUmbraco=n
	if grep -qs "Umbraco.Cms" "${_projectName}.csproj"; then _webConfigUmbraco=y; fi
	python3 "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/windows_prod.py" web-config "${_projectName}" "${PROD_ENVIRONMENT}" "${_webConfigHttps}" "${_webConfigUmbraco}" >"${_workDir}/web.config"
fi

if ((_dryRun)); then
	((_hasWebConfig)) || echo "web.config would be created."
	rclone copy "${_publish}" "${_windowsTarget}" "${_copyOpts[@]}" --dry-run
	echo "Dry run completed."
	exit 0
fi

windows_take_offline

echo "Copy to ${PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE}"
rclone copy "${_publish}" "${_windowsTarget}" "${_copyOpts[@]}"

if ((_hasWebConfig)); then
	echo "web.config already exists on the server - not touched"
else
	echo "Create web.config"
	rclone copyto "${_workDir}/web.config" "${_windowsTarget}/web.config"
fi

windows_bring_online

# The first request starts the app, which is why this can take a while.
echo "Check ${_siteUrl}"
_httpStatus=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 180 "${_siteUrl}" || true)
if [[ ${_httpStatus} =~ ^[234] ]]; then
	echo "OK: ${_siteUrl} answered with HTTP ${_httpStatus}"
elif ((_firstPublish)); then
	# The first publish has no ConnectionStrings, and DNS or the IIS binding may not be ready yet.
	echo "WARNING: ${_siteUrl} answered with HTTP ${_httpStatus}. Set the connection string in appsettings.json on the server if the site needs one, and check the IIS binding."
else
	echo "FAILED: ${_siteUrl} answered with HTTP ${_httpStatus}. Check the log on the Windows server." >&2
	exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash
# Publish this C# site to a production server over SSH.
# Creates the folder, systemd service, Apache config and certificate on prod if they are missing.
# Requirements on prod: VNS.Linux apache/init.sh has been run, and the login is root or has passwordless sudo.
# DNS for PROD_BINDING must point to the prod server before the certificate can be issued.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cd ..
set -euo pipefail

# ---- Production settings --------------------------------------------------
PROD_IP=""                      # IP or hostname of the production server
PROD_USER="root"                # SSH login
PROD_PASSWORD=""                # SSH password (needs sshpass). Leave empty to use an SSH key
PROD_SSH_PORT=22
PROD_FOLDER="@SITE@"            # Folder name on prod (/var/www/<folder>)
PROD_BINDING="@BINDING@"        # Public domain on prod, e.g. account.vns.dk
PROD_PORT_HTTP="@PORT_HTTP@"    # Local Kestrel port on prod (must be unused there)
PROD_ENVIRONMENT="Production"
PROD_ADMIN_MAIL="@ADMIN_MAIL@"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_publishFolder=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@
_dotnetVersion=@DOTNET_VERSION@
_root=/var/www/${PROD_FOLDER}
_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "${_tmp}"' EXIT

if [[ -z ${PROD_IP} || -z ${PROD_USER} || -z ${PROD_FOLDER} || -z ${PROD_BINDING} ]]; then
	echo "Set PROD_IP, PROD_USER, PROD_FOLDER and PROD_BINDING at the top of this script" >&2
	exit 1
fi

_ssh=(ssh -p "${PROD_SSH_PORT}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new)
if [[ -n ${PROD_PASSWORD} ]]; then
	command -v sshpass >/dev/null || { echo "sshpass is required for password login: sudo apt install sshpass" >&2; exit 1; }
	export SSHPASS=${PROD_PASSWORD}
	_ssh=(sshpass -e "${_ssh[@]}")
fi
_target=${PROD_USER}@${PROD_IP}
_sudo=""
[[ ${PROD_USER} == root ]] || _sudo="sudo -n"

remote() { "${_ssh[@]}" "${_target}" "$@"; }
_rsyncShell="${_ssh[*]}"

echo "Publish locally"
dotnet publish -c Release -p:PublishDir="${_tmp}/out" /p:EnvironmentName="${PROD_ENVIRONMENT}" --self-contained false --nologo
rm -f "${_tmp}"/out/appsettings-schema*.json "${_tmp}"/out/umbraco-package-schema.json
rm -rf "${_tmp}/out/App_Plugins"

_umbraco=0
[[ -f ${_tmp}/out/Umbraco.Cms.Core.dll ]] && _umbraco=1

echo "Prepare ${PROD_FOLDER} on ${PROD_IP}"
remote "${_sudo} env SITE='${PROD_FOLDER}' BINDING='${PROD_BINDING}' PORT='${PROD_PORT_HTTP}' ENVIRONMENT='${PROD_ENVIRONMENT}' MAIL='${PROD_ADMIN_MAIL}' PROJECT='${_projectName}' PUBLISH='${_publishFolder}' UMBRACO='${_umbraco}' DOTNET='${_dotnetVersion}' bash -s" <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
root=/var/www/${SITE}
docroot=${root}/${PUBLISH}/wwwroot
conf=/etc/apache2/sites-available/${SITE}.conf
service=/etc/systemd/system/${SITE}.service
certdir=/etc/ssl/certs/${SITE}_ecc
acme=/etc/acmesh/acme.sh

mkdir -p "${root}/${PUBLISH}" "${docroot}" "/var/lib/vns-roots/${SITE}"
if [[ -e ${service} ]]; then
	systemctl stop "${SITE}" || true
fi

if [[ ! -e ${service} ]]; then
	echo "Create service"
	cat >"${service}" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Running .NET Core [${SITE}]

[Service]
User=www-data
Group=www-data
WorkingDirectory=${root}/${PUBLISH}
ExecStart=/usr/lib/dotnet/dotnet ${root}/${PUBLISH}/${PROJECT}.dll --urls "http://localhost:${PORT}"
RestartSec=10
Restart=always
KillSignal=SIGINT
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=${SITE}
Environment=ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=${ENVIRONMENT}
Environment=DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=${ENVIRONMENT}
Environment=ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
RootDirectory=/var/lib/vns-roots/${SITE}
BindReadOnlyPaths=/usr/lib/dotnet /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /lib64 /usr/lib/ssl -/usr/share/zoneinfo -/usr/share/ca-certificates /etc/ssl /etc/ld.so.cache /etc/resolv.conf /etc/hosts /etc/nsswitch.conf /etc/passwd /etc/group /etc/localtime /etc/os-release
BindPaths=${root}
MountAPIVFS=yes
ReadWritePaths=${root}/${PUBLISH}

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# Upload the already published output (run publish_local.sh first) of this C# site to a production server over SSH,
# or into a local folder when PROD_LOCAL_PATH is set (e.g. a second copy of the site on this server).
# Creates the folder, systemd service, Apache config and certificate on the target if they are missing.
# Requirements on prod: VNS.Linux apache/init.sh has been run, and the login is root or has passwordless sudo.
# DNS for PROD_BINDING must point to the target server before the certificate can be issued.
# With PROD_LOCAL_PATH use a PROD_FOLDER, PROD_BINDING and port that differ from this test site.
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cd ..
set -euo pipefail

# ---- Production settings --------------------------------------------------
PROD_LOCAL_PATH=""               # Optional: publish to this local folder (e.g. /var/www/_Prod) instead of a remote server
PROD_IP=""                      # IP or hostname of the production server
PROD_USER="root"                # SSH login
PROD_PASSWORD=""                # SSH password (needs sshpass). Leave empty to use an SSH key
PROD_SSH_PORT=22
PROD_FOLDER="@SITE@"            # Folder name on prod (/var/www/<folder>)
PROD_BINDING="@BINDING@"        # Public domain on prod, e.g. account.vns.dk
PROD_PORT_HTTP=$((@PORT_HTTP@ + 2000))   # Local Kestrel port on prod: test port + 2000, so it cannot clash with sites created locally on prod
PROD_ENVIRONMENT="Production"
PROD_ADMIN_MAIL="@ADMIN_MAIL@"
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_projectName=@PROJECT_NAME@
_publishFolder=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@
_local=0
[[ -n ${PROD_LOCAL_PATH} ]] && _local=1
if ((_local)); then
	_root=${PROD_LOCAL_PATH%/}
	_sudo=""
	[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || _sudo="sudo"
else
	_root=/var/www/${PROD_FOLDER}
fi

_rsyncShell=""
_rsyncPath=""
if [[ -z ${PROD_FOLDER} || -z ${PROD_BINDING} ]]; then
	echo "Set PROD_FOLDER and PROD_BINDING at the top of this script" >&2
	exit 1
fi
if ((! _local)); then
	if [[ -z ${PROD_IP} || -z ${PROD_USER} ]]; then
		echo "Set PROD_IP and PROD_USER (or PROD_LOCAL_PATH) at the top of this script" >&2
		exit 1
	fi

	_ssh=(ssh -p "${PROD_SSH_PORT}" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new)
	if [[ -n ${PROD_PASSWORD} ]]; then
		command -v sshpass >/dev/null || { echo "sshpass is required for password login: sudo apt install sshpass" >&2; exit 1; }
		export SSHPASS=${PROD_PASSWORD}
		_ssh=(sshpass -e "${_ssh[@]}")
	fi
	_target=${PROD_USER}@${PROD_IP}
	_sudo=""
	[[ ${PROD_USER} == root ]] || _sudo="sudo -n"
	_rsyncShell="${_ssh[*]}"
	_rsyncPath="${_sudo:+${_sudo} }rsync"

remote() { "${_ssh[@]}" "${_target}" "$@"; }

run_script() {
	if ((_local)); then
		${_sudo} env ${_vars} bash -s
	else
		remote "${_sudo} env ${_vars} bash -s"
	fi
}

	echo "Nothing to upload: ${_publishFolder}/${_projectName}.dll not found. Run publish_local.sh first." >&2
	exit 1

_umbraco=0
[[ -f ${_publishFolder}/Umbraco.Cms.Core.dll ]] && _umbraco=1

_vars="SITE='${PROD_FOLDER}' BINDING='${PROD_BINDING}' PORT='${PROD_PORT_HTTP}' ENVIRONMENT='${PROD_ENVIRONMENT}' MAIL='${PROD_ADMIN_MAIL}' PROJECT='${_projectName}' UMBRACO='${_umbraco}' ROOT='${_root}'"

set -euo pipefail
root=${ROOT}
docroot=${root}/wwwroot
conf=/etc/apache2/sites-available/${SITE}.conf
service=/etc/systemd/system/${SITE}.service
certdir=/etc/ssl/certs/${SITE}_ecc
acme=/etc/acmesh/acme.sh

	exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "${docroot}" "/var/lib/vns-roots/${SITE}"
if [[ -e ${service} ]]; then
	echo "Stop service"
	systemctl stop "${SITE}" || true
fi

if [[ ! -e ${service} ]]; then
	echo "Create service"
	cat >"${service}" <<EOF

Description=Running .NET Core [${SITE}]

User=www-data
Group=www-data
WorkingDirectory=${root}

KillSignal=SIGINT
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal
SyslogIdentifier=${SITE}
Environment=ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=${ENVIRONMENT}
Environment=DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT=${ENVIRONMENT}
Environment=ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
PrivateDevices=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid
RootDirectory=/var/lib/vns-roots/${SITE}
BindReadOnlyPaths=/usr/lib/dotnet /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /lib64 /usr/lib/ssl -/usr/share/zoneinfo -/usr/share/ca-certificates /etc/ssl /etc/ld.so.cache /etc/resolv.conf /etc/hosts /etc/nsswitch.conf /etc/passwd /etc/group /etc/localtime /etc/os-release

	systemctl daemon-reload

fi

  </Directory>
</VirtualHost>

  ProxyPassReverse /sitemap.xml http://localhost:${PORT}/seo_sitemap_xml

  ProxyPassReverse / http://localhost:${PORT}/

  SSLCertificateKeyFile ${certdir}/${SITE}.key

#!/bin/bash
# Mirror Umbraco content folders (uSync, Views, css, scripts) from this site's publish folder to the Windows server.
# Each folder is mirrored (files missing here are deleted on the server), like robocopy /mir.
#
# Usage:
#   sync_prod.sh              Run the sync
#   sync_prod.sh --dry-run    Show what would change, without changing anything
#
# This file contains a password: keep it readable by root only (chmod 700).
[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || exec sudo "$0" "$@"
_self=$(realpath "$0")
_scriptFolder=$(dirname "${_self}")
_siteFolder=${_scriptFolder%/scripts*}   # scripts/ or scripts/targets/<environment>/
cd "${_siteFolder}"
set -euo pipefail
source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/windows_prod.sh"

# ---- Production settings (filled in by create_prod.sh, edit if needed) -----
PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE=@PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE@   # The IIS site's folder, e.g. //server/share/site-folder
PROD_SMB_USER=@PROD_SMB_USER@
PROD_SMB_PASSWORD=@PROD_SMB_PASSWORD@
PROD_SMB_DOMAIN=@PROD_SMB_DOMAIN@         # Empty if the server is not on a domain
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_publishFolder=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@
_folders=(uSync Views wwwroot/css wwwroot/scripts)   # Add wwwroot/media to also mirror media
_rcloneOpts=(--create-empty-src-dirs --modify-window 2s --stats 0 -v)

case "${1:-}" in
	"") ;;
	--dry-run) _rcloneOpts+=(--dry-run); echo "DRY RUN: no files will be changed." ;;
	*) echo "Usage: $0 [--dry-run]" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

windows_smb_connect
# sync_env.sh sets VNS_SYNC_SOURCE when the content comes from another environment
cd "${VNS_SYNC_SOURCE:-${_publishFolder}}"

_failed=0
for _folder in "${_folders[@]}"; do
	# A missing source folder must never be treated as an empty one,
	# as the sync would then wipe the folder on the server.
	if [[ ! -d ${_folder} ]]; then
		echo "${_folder}: SKIPPED (not found in the publish folder)"
		continue
	fi
	if rclone sync "${_folder}" "${_windowsTarget}/${_folder}" "${_rcloneOpts[@]}"; then
		echo "${_folder}: OK"
	else
		echo "${_folder}: FAILED"
		_failed=$((_failed + 1))
	fi
done

if ((_failed)); then
	echo "Sync finished with errors in ${_failed} folder(s)." >&2
	exit 1
fi
echo "Sync completed."

#!/bin/bash
# Mirror Umbraco content folders (uSync, Views, css, scripts, media) from this site's publish folder to the Windows server.
# Each folder is mirrored (files missing here are deleted on the server), like robocopy /mir.
#
# Usage:
#   sync_prod.sh              Run the sync
#   sync_prod.sh --dry-run    Show what would change, without changing anything
#
# This file contains a password: keep it readable by root only (chmod 700).
[[ $EUID -eq 0 ]] || exec sudo "$0" "$@"
_self=$(realpath "$0")
_scriptFolder=$(dirname "${_self}")
_siteFolder=${_scriptFolder%/scripts*}   # scripts/ or scripts/targets/<environment>/
cd "${_siteFolder}"
set -euo pipefail
source "@APACHE_DIR@/lib/windows_prod.sh"

# ---- Production settings (filled in by create_prod.sh, edit if needed) -----
PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE=@PROD_WINDOWS_SHARE@   # The IIS site's folder, e.g. //server/share/site-folder
PROD_SMB_USER=@PROD_SMB_USER@
PROD_SMB_PASSWORD=@PROD_SMB_PASSWORD@
PROD_SMB_DOMAIN=@PROD_SMB_DOMAIN@         # Empty if the server is not on a domain
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_publishFolder=@PUBLISH_FOLDER@
_folders=(uSync Views wwwroot/css wwwroot/scripts wwwroot/media)
_rcloneOpts=(--create-empty-src-dirs --modify-window 2s --stats 0 -v)

case "${1:-}" in
	"") ;;
	--dry-run) _rcloneOpts+=(--dry-run); echo "DRY RUN: no files will be changed." ;;
	*) echo "Usage: $0 [--dry-run]" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

windows_smb_connect
# sync_env.sh sets VNS_SYNC_SOURCE when the content comes from another environment
cd "${VNS_SYNC_SOURCE:-${_publishFolder}}"

_failed=0
for _folder in "${_folders[@]}"; do
	# A missing source folder must never be treated as an empty one,
	# as the sync would then wipe the folder on the server.
	if [[ ! -d ${_folder} ]]; then
		echo "${_folder}: SKIPPED (not found in the publish folder)"
		continue
	fi
	if rclone sync "${_folder}" "${_windowsTarget}/${_folder}" "${_rcloneOpts[@]}"; then
		echo "${_folder}: OK"
	else
		echo "${_folder}: FAILED"
		_failed=$((_failed + 1))
	fi
done

if ((_failed)); then
	echo "Sync finished with errors in ${_failed} folder(s)." >&2
	exit 1
fi
echo "Sync completed."

#!/bin/bash
# Sync settings from the main site to this environment. The work is done by sync_env.sh, which only touches the
# uSync settings folders, Views, wwwroot/css and wwwroot/scripts: content and media on this environment are kept.
_self=$(realpath "$0")
_folder=$(dirname "${_self}")
_site=${_folder%/scripts*}
_site=${_site##*/}
_id=prod
[[ ${_folder} != */scripts/targets/* ]] || _id=${_folder##*/}
exec bash "@APACHE_DIR@/sync_env.sh" "${_site}" main "${_id}" "$@"
